Synthetic permission-set group aggregate-grant capture, 2026-11-09. In a fresh 30-day Developer scratch org, source API 62.0 and 67.0 tests create a permission set with API Enabled, add it to a group, calculate, remove it, and recalculate. The group-associated PermissionSet reports PermissionsApiEnabled true after the first calculation and false after removal and the second calculation. An assertion carries the JSON observations in org.tsv. Scratch deletion succeeded and the unique capture description matched exactly one Dev Hub ScratchOrgInfo record with Status Deleted.
